name: Arnold Press
summary: A dumbbell press variation with a rotation that adds extra time under tension for the front and side shoulders.
setup: Sit on a bench with back support holding dumbbells at chest height, palms facing you.
Elbows are in front of the body, upper arms close together.
Brace the core and keep the ribs down.
Use a moderate weight since rotating is demanding.
execution: Press the dumbbells up while rotating the palms to face forward.
Finish with the arms nearly straight overhead, palms forward.
Lower while rotating the palms back toward you.
Return to the start with control.
mistakes: Using momentum to rotate: go lighter and slow the tempo.
Arching the back: keep the back on the pad and ribs down.
Rushing the rotation: make it continuous across the full movement.
